questions.question: Name three types of business income and explain why a loan received is not income.
questions.expected_answer: Any three: sales (goods), fees/current income (services), rent income, interest income, commission. A loan is not income because it was not earned from the business's activities and must be repaid; it is a liability.

questions.question: Distinguish between fixed and variable expenses with two examples of each.
questions.expected_answer: Fixed: stay the same regardless of activity, e.g. rent, insurance, fixed salaries, internet contract. Variable: change with level of activity, e.g. cost of stock sold, materials/consumables, packaging, electricity in production, commission.

questions.question: A spaza shop earns sales R12 000 and commission on airtime R600. Expenses: cost of sales R7 500, rent R1 500, electricity R800, transport R400. The owner also took R500 for personal use. Calculate profit.
questions.expected_answer: Total income = R12 600. Total expenses = R7 500 + R1 500 + R800 + R400 = R10 200. Profit = R2 400. The R500 is drawings and is not an expense, so it does not affect profit.
